boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Fillmore Auditorium Box Office Hours are: Fridays 12PM-6PM 3 Hours before doors open on event days though show time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The box office accepts MasterCard, Visa, Amx, Discover. We have gone cashless at our box office window.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available on the evening of the show only approximately 30 minutes prior to the doors opening.

venues.parkingDetail: Street parking & paid lots. Arrive Early. Paid lots not affiliated with Fillmore.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an all general admission event unless otherwise noted on the map. We are offering accessible seating that you may purchase in advance for GA shows. Please be aware that stairs may restrict access to locations not marked as wheelchair accessible. ADA sections provide general admission entry to the purchased section, and seats in that section will be filled in order of arrival. A member of our team will be available to escort you to your seat once you arrive at the venue. If you do not see available accessible seats, please purchase a general admission ticket, and contact the venue so we may accommodate your request for accessible seating. We recommend that you arrive at the venue at the door time listed on the event page and talk to a member of our staff to receive accommodations.

generalInfo.generalRule: To enhance the guest experience and for your safety, the following items are prohibited from entry to the Fillmore: Cans, bottles, glass, outside food or drinks, large bags or backpacks, weapons of any kind, illegal drugs, laser pointers, video recorders, large or professional cameras, stickers, flyers, markers, glow sticks, projectiles. The Fillmore Auditorium is a no smoking facility, cigarettes and any other inhaling devices including vaporizers are prohibited inside the venue. Tobacco products may be consumed in our designated smoking area outside the South side of the venue. Marijuana products are prohibited. Per Colorado Amendment 64, public display and consumption of marijuana is prohibited by law. Crowd surfing and other behavior that may endanger the well-being of other patrons is prohibited. Small cameras and audio recording subject to artist approval. Other items may be prohibited at artist request or venue discretion. The Fillmore reserves the right to refuse entry or remove anyone for any reason. Most shows are ages 16 & over with valid ID only unless otherwise noted. Alcohol will be served to those who are 21+ with valid I.D. There are some shows that are listed as *All Ages* where there will be no age requirement for entrance. The Fillmore Auditorium is usually configured as General Admission mainly standing-room with limited seating areas available.

events.name: Jeff Goldblum and the Mildred Snitzer Orchestra
KSE Venue Ball Arena Tours
events.description:
Step behind the scenes at Ball Arena and discover what it takes to operate one of the busiest sports and entertainment venues in North America. Home to the NBA's Denver Nuggets, NHL's Colorado Avalanche, NLL's Colorado Mammoth, and a wide variety of concerts and special events, Ball Arena provides guests with a unique look at the inner workings of a world-class arena.

During this approximately 90-minute guided walking tour, guests will explore exclusive areas not typically accessible to the public, including premium suites, the Michelob ULTRA Mountain House, the arena bowl, backstage hallways, production and broadcast areas, and other operational spaces throughout the venue. Depending on availability, guests may also have the opportunity to visit team locker rooms, view the Avalanche hallway, or see the Nuggets practice court (if  available). 

Throughout the experience, guests will learn about the history of Ball Arena, major sporting events and concerts hosted at the venue, and the game-day operations that bring events to life. Tour guides will share insights into event production, security, guest experience, premium hospitality, broadcasting, facility management, and the many departments that work together to create memorable experiences for fans and guests.

ADA sections provide general admission entry to the purchased section, and seats in that section will be filled in order of arrival. A member of our team will be available to escort you to your seat once you arrive at the venue.

If you do not see available accessible seats, please purchase a general admission ticket, and contact the venue so we may accommodate your request for accessible seating. We recommend that you arrive at the venue at the door time listed on the event page and talk to a member of our staff to receive accommodations.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: o Ticketmaster will call opens one hour prior to doors or at the scheduled meet and greet check in time. Artist guest list may not arrive until doors time. venues.parkingDetail: We like to refer to our venue as an island surrounded by paid on street and off street parking. In fact, there is even a paid parking lot just to the south of our building. Please note that Marquis does not operate these parking lots and the early bird usually gets the spots. Plan, plot, and park accordingly. Marquis has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer easy and reliable parking options. Book Parking Here https://www.parkwhiz.com/marquis-theater-parking/
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: o Marquis strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible. Please visit marquisdenver.com/accessibility to learn more. For more questions, do not hesitate to get in touch with us at 303-487-0111 or marquis@livenation.com.

generalInfo.generalRule: o If you lose an item while you are at an event, please email marquis@livenation.com to see if it has been turned in. Please allow 24 to 48 hours for the team to look for your item and respond back to you. The venue is not responsible for any lost, stolen, or damaged items. As a courtesy, we hold lost items for 30 days. o Marquis is proud to offer pizza by the slice from Denvers favorite Marquis Pizza. We also offer a wide variety of beverage options at any of our bars throughout the venue. o Marquis is a cashless music venue. We accept only card and contactless payment at all points of sale (box office excluded). If needed, please visit either our box office or bar to convert your cash to a prepaid card. These cards are fee free, can be used anywhere that accepts Mastercard, and can be loaded with any amount needed. Artist merch vendors are permitted to manage their own cash sales. o A valid ID is required to attend any age restricted events and to consume alcohol. Accepted forms of identification include state-issued ID or Drivers License, valid nonexpired US Government or Military ID, or an official passport.  Marquis has a very strict underage drinking policy that follows state law, and if you do not have acceptable ID that states your age at 21 or older, you will be considered the same as a minor and will not be able to purchase, consume, or possess alcohol in the venue. Violators will be removed from the building without warnings and will not be eligible for a refund.  Age requirements differ depending on the event. All age requirements are listed directly on the event page. If no age restriction is listed, the event is all ages. o Customer Safety information and restricted items list available here https://www.livenation.com/venueguidelines
